# Cinder Fox fixture

The model, animations and controller of the sample mob `sample_mobs:cinder_fox` (FR-F4-MOBS.md section 10), as test data
for `horizon-mobmodel`. Everything here is original and generated by `gen_cinder_fox.py`: a fox made of boxes, hand-written
keyframes and expressions, painted pixels. Nothing comes from GeckoLib or Minecraft.

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `cinder_fox.bbmodel` | Blockbench project: 14 groups, 14 cubes, locator `mouth`, 64x64 texture embedded, `animations[]` (Blockbench form) |
| `cinder_fox.geo.json` | The same model as Bedrock geometry 1.12.0 |
| `cinder_fox.animation.json` | Bedrock animations: `idle` (loop), `walk` (loop, clock speed from `q.ground_speed`), `run` (loop), `sit` (hold), `pounce` (once, 0.8 s, `hit` event at 0.35 s with sound and particle), `death` (hold) |
| `cinder_fox.json` | Controller (section 6.1 format): layers `locomotion`, `action` (trigger `pounce`), `pose` (`sit` from `q.synced('state')`) |
| `cinder_fox.png`, `cinder_fox_glowmask.png` | 64x64 texture and the emissive mask (two eye texels and the tail tip) |
| `golden_poses.txt` | 30-frame golden pose table of every animation (bone matrices), checked by `tests/cinder_fox.rs` |
| `gen_cinder_fox.py` | The generator |

Bones (depth first): `root`, `body`, `head`, `ear_l`, `ear_r`, `snout`, `jaw`, `leg_fl`, `leg_fr`, `leg_bl`, `leg_br`,
`tail1`, `tail2`, `tail3`. The design list names 13 (root, body, head, ears x2, snout, legs x4, tail x3) and asks for 14;
`jaw` is the extra one (it opens on the pounce). Rotated bones: both ears, all three tail bones; a rotated cube: `tuft`. Box
UV on most cubes, per-face UV (with a UV rotation and the up/down flip) on `snout` and the tail tip, and a mirrored box UV on
`ear_r` and the right legs.

## Regenerate

```
cd crates/horizon-mobmodel/tests/fixtures/cinder_fox
python gen_cinder_fox.py                      # model, animations, controller, textures (deterministic)
cd ../../../../..
MOBMODEL_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 cargo test -p horizon-mobmodel --test cinder_fox golden    # pose tables
```

The first `golden_poses.txt` was produced by `horizon-mobmodel` itself: it pins today's behaviour, it was not compared with
Blockbench or GeckoLib output. Review its diff whenever you regenerate it.

## Both routes

The animations are written once, in Bedrock space; the bbmodel `animations[]` is derived from them by the inverse of the
loader's conversion (position x and rotation x, y negated, expressions wrapped as `-(...)`). The tests check that the two
routes give the same pose tables **except on the leaf bones that use `easing`**: Blockbench's bbmodel keyframe has no
easing or `easingArgs`, so the bbmodel copy drops them (listed in `FR-F4M-FOX.md`). Events at the same time come out in a
different order in the two routes.

## Sync fixtures

Synced enum `state` (slot 0): idle = 0, sit = 1, pounce = 2. Golden ground speeds: `walk` 0.12, `run` 0.3, others 0.
